# KeyPresser

> KeyPresser Professional and KeyPresserNext are Windows desktop automation tools. Professional separates keyboard, mouse, image recognition, and recording into modules. Next combines actions in one editable workflow. KeyPresser 专业版和 KeyPresserNext 是两款不同的 Windows 键鼠自动化工具。

## Products / 产品

- [KeyPresser Professional](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html): Windows macro recorder and keyboard and mouse automation, with English and Simplified Chinese desktop interfaces.
- [KeyPresser 专业版](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/): 窗口录制回放、定时按键、鼠标助手、识图和 Python 脚本。
- [Professional 6.5.2 release and SHA-256](https://github.com/FinnWang-CN/KeyPresser/releases/tag/v6.5.2): Official English Windows download, release notes and checksum.
- [Professional pricing in USD](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/pricing.html): PayPal, one-time payments, no automatic renewal.
- [KeyPresserNext English product information](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html): Unified action editor, editable recordings, and a 15-day trial without registration. The desktop interface is available in Simplified Chinese.
- [KeyPresserNext 中文介绍](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next.html): 编辑键鼠和识图动作，支持顺序与独立运行。

## Tutorials and answers / 教程与解答

- [Record and replay Notepad++ tab clicks](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/notepad-plus-plus-macro-tutorial.html): Record two clicks and replay the sequence three times using Window Recorder.
- [Repeat a key at a fixed interval on Windows](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/repeat-keypresses-windows.html): Configure a key row for a 1,000 ms interval in Notepad.
- [Professional FAQ](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/index-en.html#faq) · [专业版常见问题](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/#faq)
- [KeyPresserNext FAQ](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html#faq) · [Next 常见问题](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next.html#faq)
- [Next MCP and DeepSeek Harness setup](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next-en.html#agent) · [Next MCP 与 DeepSeek Harness 接入](https://keypresser.onepeak.cn/keypresser-next.html#agent)
